newsitem.title: UK: KVAERNER TO MERGE NORWAY OIL, GAS FIRMS.
newsitem.headline: KVAERNER TO MERGE NORWAY OIL, GAS FIRMS.

text.p: Norwegian engineering group Kvaerner ASA said on Monday it planned to merge its oil and gas companies in Norway to form a new and more competitively-placed company.

In an attempt to boost its chances of winning larger turnkey contracts, the company said Kvaerner Engineering, Kvaerner Rosenberg, Kvaerner Installasjon and Kvaerner Concrete Construction were joining forces to form a new company called Kvaerner Oil & Gas.
The company will employ 9,000 staff, including subcontractors, in Norway.
"One of our main goals is to achieve a radical and permanent improvement in our competitive ability," Ingebrigt Moum, president of Kvaerner Oil & Gas, said in a statement released in London.
"Our major customers are positive about the restructuring and the measures we're now carrying out -- something we regard as very important."
Kvaerner said the new company's areas would be field developments in Norway, international field developments, modification and maintenance contracts and onshore facilities.
Kvaerner Oil & Gas has an order reserve of around $2 billion and its annual turnover has increased by more than 60 percent since last year.
